oss_reference.description: haimingz/vivsim buffer-layer-2to1-refinement: FH rescaling, cell-block upsampling, 2:1 sub-cycling, no time interpolation, no reflux

comparison.note: OSS reference diverged after 2000 steps due to lack of reflux mechanism

short_time_comparison.note: At 100 steps, both implementations produce identical results

time_interpolation.tensorlbm: Linear time interpolation between t and t+dt at ghost fills

reflux.tensorlbm: Inventory reflux (global mass normalisation ~1e-6 per step)
reflux.oss: No reflux (mass not conserved at interface); minimal mass correction applied for stability

verdict: TensorLBM implementation matches OSS reference in core algorithm (FH rescaling, upsampling, restriction). TensorLBM is more stable long-term due to inventory reflux mechanism. Short-time results are identical (<0.001% difference). Long-time OSS reference diverges without reflux.
